$comment: Design report (design-report/SCREENS-ALL.md): the screens beyond the 15 suite screens, by native launch route (clients/ios ParityLaunch.swift). `absent` names the evidence for a screen the iOS app does not have.

absent.login-qr: No QR sign-in in the iOS app: clients/ios/Sources/PlayarrApp/Views/LoginView.swift has server, username and password fields and an invitation sign-up sheet only (no QR or device-code flow; the only QR code is the calendar subscription sheet and the settings invite).
absent.link: No device link code screen: the iOS app signs in with credentials; searched clients/ios/Sources/PlayarrApp for link code, device link and /link routes (none).
absent.household: No household route: the only household UI is the HouseholdBlockedView overlay (a limit-reached block, Views/HouseholdBlockedView.swift) shown by HouseholdViewModel when the server blocks a profile; the Destination enum in Views/RootView.swift has no household entry.
absent.folders: No folders screen: the Destination enum in Views/RootView.swift lists downloads, search, home, libraries, playlists, watchlist, requests and calendar; folders exist only as playlist child counts inside PlaylistsView.swift.
absent.episode-detail: Same screen as series-detail: episodes are rows inside WorkDetailView (Views/WorkDetailView.swift); there is no separate episode route.
absent.not-found: No not-found screen: the app navigates by the Destination enum and NavigationStack values, not by URL, so no unknown-route fallback exists (Views/RootView.swift).
